@utility chip-3d.background-image:
linear-gradient(
    to bottom,
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 7%, white),
    color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 17%, white)
  )
@utility chip-3d.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 var(--hairline)
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 30%, transparent),
    inset 0 -1px 0
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 26%, transparent),
    0 1px 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 16%, transparent)

&:where(.dark, .dark *).background-image:
linear-gradient(
      to bottom,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 16%, transparent),
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 24%, transparent)
    )
&:where(.dark, .dark *).box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 var(--hairline)
        color-mix(in oklab, var(--chip, currentcolor) 36%, transparent),
      inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 6%)

@utility keycap-3d.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 var(--hairline) var(--border),
    inset 0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 5%),
    0 1px 1.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 5%)

@utility gem-plate.box-shadow:
inset 0 0 0 var(--hairline) rgb(255 255 255 / 28%),
    inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 22%),
    0 0 0 var(--hairline)
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--gem, currentcolor) 40%, transparent),
    0 1px 1.5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--gem, currentcolor) 28%, transparent)

@utility surface-brand.box-shadow:
0 0 0 var(--hairline) color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 35%, var(--border)),
    0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 4%)

*,\n ::before,\n ::after.transition-property:
opacity, color, background-color, border-color, outline-color, box-shadow,
      fill, stroke

items.title: Invite flow
items.description: A sheet with Invite and Invited tabs that turns addresses into chips, beside the list of pending invitations it keeps up to date.

items.name: team-04
items.title: Team overview
items.description: A team page with its figures for this week or last, the members with their current task and hours, and the activity of the person picked.

items.name: application-01
items.title: Team workspace
items.description: A Mossline workspace: a sidebar that hides and goes into a sheet on phones, My tasks grouped by status whose rows open a task drawer, an inbox behind the bell and as a page, a board whose moves change the same tasks, and the team with time today.

items.name: application-02
items.title: Analytics
items.description: Tidewell Studio reports in the sidebar shell: an overview whose figures pick what the chart draws, a weekly report with day bars and ranked projects, and project health against the sprint goal, each with a CSV export.

items.name: application-03
items.title: Settings
items.description: Lattice Studio settings: a settings rail with a way back to the app, a profile, notifications by channel and the workspace page, each saving through one unsaved-changes bar, with saved names showing in the sidebar at once.

items.name: application-04
items.title: Sign in
items.description: A focused Loomboard page: sign in with a one-time code, with links to create an account and to reset a password, all in one card that resizes from one flow to the next.

items.name: application-05
items.title: Assistant
items.description: A Quillstone assistant: conversations on the left that go into a sheet on phones, a reply that streams in while Send becomes Stop, a composer that takes files and a model, a reply that folds its reasoning and runs two tool calls, and a new chat that starts from suggested prompts.

items.name: marketing-01
items.title: Planning board landing page
items.description: A Loomboard home page: a navbar with sliding menu panels, a hero with a working board whose cards drag between lanes by pointer or keyboard, a marquee of placeholder marks, four views beside a live preview, a call to action and a footer with a newsletter field.

items.name: marketing-02
items.title: Newsletter landing page
items.description: A Fernpost home page: a floating navbar, a waitlist hero that morphs into its confirmation, alternating feature rows, two plans with a Monthly and Yearly switch, questions on one card, an SDK install card and a compact footer.

items.name: marketing-03
items.title: Per-seat pricing page
items.description: A Tallyfold pricing page: one plan whose seat count and monthly total roll to their new value when changed, a grouped table of what it includes, questions on one card and a compact footer.

items.name: marketing-04
items.title: Changelog page
items.description: A Loomboard changelog: the navbar with Changelog marked, dated releases with their kind of change and a Load more that adds the next ones, and a footer with a newsletter field.

items.name: marketing-05
items.title: Contact page
items.description: A Driftdesk contact page: contact details beside a form that checks each field, shows a sending state and morphs into a confirmation, grouped questions and a compact footer.
